channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
channel.desc: It's Children's week. In the Pattern Challenge, the sewers tackle a children's tutu. In the Transformation Challenge, sustainability is key as the sewers repurpose fleece into stuffed animal toys with adorable results. And finally, mini models are welcomed into the sewing room for the Made-to-Measure Challenge. The sewers are tasked with creating an outfit for their very own superhero creations. Who will handle it like child's play, and who will be sent to the naughty step?
